subject: Mathematics
title: Financial Transaction
learningOutcomes: Calculate simple interest, amount, rate, time and principal using \(I = \frac{PRT}{100}\).
Calculate the amount and compound interest using \(A = P\left(1+\frac{R}{100}\right)^n\).
Work out the downpayment, monthly instalment and hire-purchase price of an item.
Convert an amount from one currency to another using a given exchange rate.
Find insurance premiums, allowing for depreciation of a vehicle's value.
Distribute an inheritance by the Islamic laws and share partnership profit by investment.

sections.heading: Simple and Compound Interest
sections.body: Simple interest is always worked out on the original principal, so the yearly interest is the same: \(I = \frac{P \times R \times T}{100}\) and the amount \(A = P + I\). Compound interest is worked out on the principal and on the interest already earned, so it grows faster: \(A = P\left(1+\frac{R}{100}\right)^n\) and \(\text{C.I.} = A - P\). Compounded half-yearly uses rate \(\frac{R}{2}\) over \(2n\) periods; monthly uses \(\frac{R}{12}\) over \(12n\).

sections.heading: Hire Purchase
sections.body: Hire purchase means buying by an initial downpayment followed by regular instalments. Interest is charged on the balance, so the hire-purchase price is more than the cash price. \(\text{HP price} = \text{Downpayment} + (\text{Instalment} \times \text{No. of instalments})\), and the extra paid is the hire-purchase price minus the cash price.

sections.heading: Money Exchange
sections.body: Different countries use different currencies, exchanged using a given rate. To convert, first find the value of one unit and then multiply by the amount. For example, if A$1 = S$1.0318 then A$543 = 1.0318 × 543 = S$560.27.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.body: Insurance protects a person against loss to life or property in return for a premium: \(\text{Premium} = \frac{R}{100} \times \text{insured value}\). A vehicle's value falls over time (depreciation), so each year's premium is worked out on the new, lower value.

sections.heading: Inheritance and Partnership
sections.body: By the Islamic laws of inheritance the widow receives \(\frac{1}{8}\) of the estate and the rest is shared so that a son inherits twice a daughter's share (if the widow is deceased, no widow's share is taken out). In a partnership, equal investments for the same time share the profit equally, while different investments share the profit in the ratio of the amounts invested.

definitions.definition: The original sum of money borrowed or lent.
Interest worked out only on the original principal.
Interest worked out on the principal and on the interest already earned.
Total price paid by downpayment plus instalments (more than the cash price).
How much of one currency is equal to another currency.
The amount paid for an insurance policy.
The fall in the market value of a vehicle over time.
A business run by two or more people who share the profit.

examTips: For simple interest, if the time is in months use \(T = \frac{\text{months}}{12}\) years (unless the rate itself is per month).
The compound formula gives the amount \(A\) first — always subtract the principal to get the interest.
In inheritance, take out the widow's \(\frac{1}{8}\) first, then split the rest with a son counted as 2 and a daughter as 1.
